thesis: Black Vise punishes the resource most players normally want—cards in hand—making it strongest when mana denial or a fast clock prevents those cards from being deployed.

canonicalIdentity.originalPrintedText: As this artifact enters, choose an opponent. At the beginning of the chosen player's upkeep, this artifact deals X damage to that player, where X is the number of cards in their hand minus 4.
